caption: The drawing depicts a round ceramic plate with a reddish-brown background and decorated with green and teal patterns. In the center of the plate, there is a stylized bird facing left, rendered in shades of green and teal, with a long tail extending to the right. Surrounding the bird are several botanical elements, such as leaves, buds, and abstract flower shapes, all in similar green and teal tones. The border of the plate is adorned with a repeating decorative motif comprised of leaf-like shapes and curving lines in green, outlined with lighter and darker shades for accent. The plate sits on a neutral, slightly off-white background, and the lower right portion near the rim of the plate has a handwritten signature, "M. L. Gretton."
title: Plate
